source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

textbook_summary: P waves are absent; fibrillatory f waves vary in amplitude, morphology and interval, are prominent in V1, and may be coarse or fine.
The f-wave rate is 350-600/min; RR intervals are completely irregular and QRS complexes are usually narrow.
limitations: The f-wave table repeats every 16.384 s; it is a fixed authored example, not a calibrated physiological or statistical model of AF.
RR jitter is bounded and derived from beat-index hashes without stateful random numbers. This is not an AV-node conduction model; the long-term mean ventricular rate is 75/min.
No aberrant conduction, AF with complete AV block, or filling, stroke-volume or pulse-deficit feedback.
Mechanical ejection follows the electrical event by 80 ms. Pressure morphology uses the minimum RR as its reference; pulse duration is 360 ms and QT is fixed at 300 ms.
